title: A Ghost for the Border
premise: Silas Delacroix, a private security contractor hiding from his role in a botched extraction that killed his team, receives a calendar invite from his dead handler, Marek, scheduling a meeting for the eve of a high-stakes border summit. Following the trail, Silas uncovers a plot by his own employer's leadership to stage a catastrophic 'accident' at the summit to justify a lucrative security contract expansion—and to bury Silas along with the evidence. Betrayed by his last loyal friend, Silas must expose the conspiracy in real time, choosing truth over survival, and ends the book testifying anonymously while finally sleeping through the night.
about_author: Ivo Lockridge is the pen name of a former logistics consultant who spent a decade working alongside private security firms before turning to fiction. He writes from a coastal town he refuses to name, drawing on the moral gray zones he witnessed firsthand.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Insomniac and half-retired, Silas receives a calendar invite from Marek Voss—his handler, dead for eight months—for a meeting tomorrow at a decommissioned border station. He goes, finding only a burner phone and a cached file hinting at an 'accident' planned during the summit. The emotional beat is dread curdling into reluctant purpose: the past has found him, and running is no longer an option.

chapters.title: Dead Drop Protocol
chapters.summary: Alternating POV between Silas and Ana Reyes, Marek's former analyst who never believed he died. They decode Marek's dead drops, discovering the plot traces to Halcyon Group's board—Silas's own employer. The emotional beat is wary alliance: two people bound by loyalty to a dead man, testing whether they can trust each other more than the institution that trained them.

chapters.title: The Summit's Shadow
chapters.summary: Silas's POV, embedded back inside Halcyon under cover of a routine audit. He identifies the sabotage mechanism—a compromised cargo route timed to fail during the summit motorcade—but is betrayed by his oldest teammate, Dario, who reports him to the board. The emotional beat is the crushing cost of loyalty: Silas realizes the brotherhood he mourned was complicit all along, and now he's the loose end scheduled to disappear.

chapters.title: What the Night Owls Saw
chapters.summary: Climactic dual POV. Silas, hunted, races to trigger Marek's dead-man's-switch broadcast while Ana stalls the summit motorcade with a fabricated inspection delay. The 'accident' fails; Dario dies covering Silas's escape, a final act of divided loyalty. Weeks later, Silas testifies under protection. The resolution's emotional beat is quiet: the price of survival was his invisibility, and giving it up is what finally lets him sleep.
